title: Normalized slice tensor comparison preserves associators
statement: For a small ringed site and its slice [def-weil-size-convention, def-pur-localized-ringed-site], fix the derived closed structures, K-flat tensor comparisons and full tensor coherences [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal, def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. A slice tensor comparison normalized on flat-term K-flat representatives [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-evaluation-transpose] preserves the derived associator: restriction of reassociation followed by the two right-nested comparisons equals the two left-nested comparisons followed by reassociation on the slice.

proof.text: Choose flat-term K-flat representatives for three arguments. Their two total products are flat-term and K-flat. The tensor normalization supplies four comparison squares; the full coherences supply the source and slice reassociation maps.

Restriction of reassociation followed by the right nested tensor comparison equals the left nested comparison followed by slice reassociation. Detect equality on triple local pure tensors using tensor-Hom currying, sheafification and coproduct universal properties. Each side sends the three generators to the same nested generator without a sign.

Localize the chain equation and use naturality of the localization isomorphism and of tensor-model comparisons to combine the four squares. Cancel the model isomorphisms to obtain the associator equation on representatives. Transport it along resolving quasi-isomorphisms to arbitrary derived objects by tensor-comparison and associator naturality. The site tensor-right comparison transports flatness between the abstract tensor-right functor and IsFlatOnSite.

theorem ringedSlice_tensor_associator :
    let r := ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, r, w, w'} J R U
    ∀ X Y Z,
      r.map (S.monoidal.associator X Y Z).hom ≫
        (d.rho X (S.tensor.obj (Y, Z))).hom ≫
        SU.tensor.map
          (X := (r.obj X, r.obj (S.tensor.obj (Y, Z))))
          (Y := (r.obj X, SU.tensor.obj (r.obj Y, r.obj Z)))
          (𝟙 (r.obj X), (d.rho Y Z).hom) =
      (d.rho (S.tensor.obj (X, Y)) Z).hom ≫
        SU.tensor.map
          (X := (r.obj (S.tensor.obj (X, Y)), r.obj Z))
          (Y := (SU.tensor.obj (r.obj X, r.obj Y), r.obj Z))
          ((d.rho X Y).hom, 𝟙 (r.obj Z)) ≫
        (SU.monoidal.associator (r.obj X) (r.obj Y) (r.obj Z)).hom
